channel_fit.reason: The group site itself draws little demand.

conversion_action.reason: 'Contact'; the brands and subsidiaries have their own sites.

customer_type.reason: Software for insurers, MGAs and brokers, plus its own online insurance brands for consumers and businesses.

ticket_band.reason: Software contracts and consumer policies differ too much to name one value.

draft.phrase_note: A holding-company site: the selling happens on the subsidiaries' and brands' own sites.

principal_activity: The principal activity of the company and group continued to be that of the provision of insurance services.
